coordinate_system: All *_source_xywh fields are integer pixels in the original source PNG, origin top-left; [x,y,width,height]. frame index is 1-based.
scope: All 156 runtime frames were visually checked; output statuses are in oichi-skirt.json.

reference_interpretation.heavy1_tick: Small white hem and narrow side lining are acceptable.
reference_interpretation.air_heavy_cross: The large white hip/shorts panel is unacceptable even if the skirt otherwise looks the same.

roi_type: Conservative manually reviewed containment envelopes, not pixel-level segmentation masks. All visible white underwear regions fit inside their per-frame envelope; never use the envelope as an unconditional paste mask.
classification_note: Borderline narrow liners were kept where their shape follows the slit rather than forming a wide leg opening. medium confidence marks these retained slivers for final visual judgement, not an unreviewed frame.
